name: The Family Crypt
summary: Scourge forces press the Forsaken at Agamand Mills. From Brill, Magistrate Sevren sends agents to strike the undead in the family crypt.

sections.title: A Foxtrot in Tirisfal
sections.body: The Forsaken hold Tirisfal Glades, though the Scourge still commands much of its countryside. The Agamand Mills once ground flour for Lordaeron. Now the mills shelter the Scourge. In Brill, Magistrate Sevren watches the enemy gather with grave concern. Every stretch of land lost to the undead weakens the Forsaken's independence.

sections.title: Defiling the Tomb
sections.body: Captain Dargol, a skeletal commander, has made the Agamand Family Crypt his headquarters. He uses necromancy to raise generations of the Agamand dead as Rotting and Wailing Ancestors, swelling his ranks. Magistrate Sevren sends Forsaken agents to purge the crypt and lay its disturbed dead to rest. He also wants Dargol's head, to disrupt Scourge forces in northern Tirisfal.

faq.answer: Captain Dargol is a skeletal Scourge officer based in the Agamand Family Crypt. He commands local Scourge forces and uses necromancy to raise Agamand ancestors against the Forsaken.

faq.q: Why does Magistrate Sevren care about the Agamand Mills?
faq.answer: The Agamand Mills are a major Scourge foothold near Brill and the Undercity. Captain Dargol's growing force of raised ancestors threatens Forsaken settlements.

faq.q: Who are the Wailing and Rotting Ancestors?
faq.answer: The Wailing and Rotting Ancestors are dead forebears of the wealthy Agamand family. Captain Dargol's necromancy has corrupted them and bound them to the Scourge.

faq.q: What happens after Dargol is killed?
faq.answer: When you return Captain Dargol's skull to Magistrate Sevren, the Scourge loses its central leadership at the mills. Sevren hails the victory as a critical strike for the Forsaken and an early step toward purging the Lich King's influence from Lordaeron.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you see Captain Dargol embody the enslavement to the Lich King's will your people fought to escape. Putting down the raised ancestors protects the Forsaken and helps break the Scourge's hold on their homeland.
As a member of the Horde, you help secure Tirisfal Glades, anchor the Horde's presence in the Eastern Kingdoms, and remove immediate threats to its northern stronghold.
